gate.behavior: The dependency audit blocks when metadata high plus critical is greater than zero. Low and moderate findings do not block. An unparsable pnpm audit payload stays fail-closed. This plan does not waive, downgrade, or retune that rule.

reconciliation.explanation: The captured payload has 36 advisory objects at high or critical. @vue/server-renderer GHSA-g2v6-rqmx-r4w6 is one object with two findings, 3.5.41 and 3.4.21. Counting findings gives 33 high and 4 critical, matching blockingVulnerabilities 37. The table has one row per finding. No advisory was added.
